evals.name: yellow-backend-alert-copy

En /orders cuando cancelo un pedido que ya salió, la alerta dice 'El pedido 8f3a2c1e-77b0-4c1e-9a51-3d0e2f6b9c10 no se puede cancelar: fue despachado el 2026-10-20T14:03:00.000Z por andreani'. assertions.text: Only backend/src/routes/orders.ts was modified

The response tells the user the change was made in the backend (names backend or orders.ts)

evals.name: red-similar-products

evals.expected_output: No edits. Alerts that there is no similar-products data or logic, and offers options, ideally including a reduced version using the existing category filter on /products.

assertions.text: No files were modified
The response explains that similar products need data or logic that doesn't exist yet (endpoint, similarity criteria, extra request)
